@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Joan's f______y about living in a magical kingdom inspired her to write stories filled with dragons and brave heroes.
= fantasy
~詞義 fantasy（n.）幻想
~原文 Joan's fantasy about living in a magical kingdom inspired her to write stories filled with dragons and brave heroes.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The workers sat i______e for hours, not doing any work because the factory machines suddenly stopped working.
= idle
~詞義 idle（adj.）無所事事的
~原文 The workers sat idle for hours, not doing any work because the factory machines suddenly stopped working.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The ballet dancer made a g______l leap into the air and then struck an ending pose.
= graceful
~詞義 graceful（adj.）優雅的
~原文 The ballet dancer made a graceful leap into the air and then struck an ending pose.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You should not exercise until your food has had a chance to d______t, or you may feel uncomfortable.
= digest
~詞義 digest（v.）消化
~原文 You should not exercise until your food has had a chance to digest, or you may feel uncomfortable.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The U.K. economy is heavily d______t on international trade. Most British companies sell their products overseas.
= dependent
~詞義 dependent（adj.）依賴的
~原文 The U.K. economy is heavily dependent on international trade. Most British companies sell their products overseas.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many people believe that children learn language through ______. That is, they just repeat what their parents and other people say.
A: admission
B: imitation
C: disadvantage
D: celebration
= B
~詞義 imitation（n.）模仿
~原文 Many people believe that children learn language through imitation. That is, they just repeat what their parents and other people say.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is much easier to ______ a point by giving examples rather than trying to explain it.
A: furnish
B: devise
C: illustrate
D: classify
= C
~詞義 illustrate（v.）說明
~原文 It is much easier to illustrate a point by giving examples rather than trying to explain it.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: John felt ______ about forgetting his girlfriend's birthday again.
A: guilty
B: delightful
C: functional
D: crunchy
= A
~詞義 guilty（adj.）內疚的
~原文 John felt guilty about forgetting his girlfriend's birthday again.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ against unfair labor practices attracted national attention and sparked important discussions.
A: illustration
B: classification
C: constitution
D: demonstration
= D
~詞義 demonstration（n.）示威
~原文 The demonstration against unfair labor practices attracted national attention and sparked important discussions.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Julia bought a birthday gift for her father to show her ______ for what he had done for her.
A: appreciation
B: emphasis
C: commerce
D: disadvantage
= A
~詞義 appreciation（n.）感激
~原文 Julia bought a birthday gift for her father to show her appreciation for what he had done for her.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: comedy
B: classified
C: confidence
D: burglar
E: dyed
F: drowsy

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The books are ______ by general subject. For example, if you want to find something related to World War I, you should go to the history section.
= B
~詞義 classify（v.）分類
~原文 The books are classified by general subject. For example, if you want to find something related to World War I, you should go to the history section.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: My house was robbed by a ______ a few months ago when we were away on a trip.
= D
~詞義 burglar（n.）竊賊
~原文 My house was robbed by a burglar a few months ago when we were away on a trip.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The actor achieved great popularity and success after appearing on the ______ show.
= A
~詞義 comedy（n.）喜劇
~原文 The actor achieved great popularity and success after appearing on the comedy show.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: You should have ______ in yourself, and I believe you can make it.
= C
~詞義 confidence（n.）信心
~原文 You should have confidence in yourself, and I believe you can make it.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: After eating the big dinner, Henry felt very ______ and lay down on the sofa.
= F
~詞義 drowsy（adj.）困倦的
~原文 After eating the big dinner, Henry felt very drowsy and lay down on the sofa.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: concerning
B: disadvantages
C: diploma
D: admission
E: crunchy
F: functional

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Those under 18 are refused ______ to the night club because it is illegal for them to drink alcohol.
= D
~詞義 admission（n.）允許進入
~原文 Those under 18 are refused admission to the night club because it is illegal for them to drink alcohol.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Stella earned a(n) ______ in nursing, which allowed her to work in hospitals and care for patients.
= C
~詞義 diploma（n.）文憑
~原文 Stella earned a(n) diploma in nursing, which allowed her to work in hospitals and care for patients.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Although the idea sounded good at first, a final evaluation revealed that its potential ______ were greater than its advantages.
= B
~詞義 disadvantage（n.）缺點
~原文 Although the idea sounded good at first, a final evaluation revealed that its potential disadvantages were greater than its advantages.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: To make sure the alarm clock was ______, Andy tested it before going to bed.
= F
~詞義 functional（adj.）正常使用的
~原文 To make sure the alarm clock was functional, Andy tested it before going to bed.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: If you want to learn more about issues ______ gender or race, you should read this magazine.
= A
~詞義 concerning（prep.）關於
~原文 If you want to learn more about issues concerning gender or race, you should read this magazine.
